name: High fall risk
taskPlanEffect: Add transfer/ambulation precautions, supervision and fall-prevention controls as assessed.

name: Reduced transfer ability
taskPlanEffect: Increase transfer assistance and equipment requirements according to assessment.

name: Cognitive impairment
taskPlanEffect: Add cueing, supervision and communication adaptations; do not assume dementia solely from a score.

name: Behavioral symptoms
taskPlanEffect: Add individualized trigger management and supervision.
escalationLink: Significant escalation/injury risk → DT-003/DT-007 as applicable

name: Medication complexity/high-risk medication
taskPlanEffect: Add only clinically authorized monitoring/support and risk controls.

name: Swallowing/dysphagia risk
taskPlanEffect: Add clinically specified meal positioning, assistance and observation.

name: Poor intake/dehydration risk
taskPlanEffect: Add intake monitoring and defined escalation thresholds once clinically approved.

name: Recent hospitalization / acute change
taskPlanEffect: Add temporary enhanced monitoring and transition/reconciliation tasks.

name: Skin/wound risk
taskPlanEffect: Add specified prevention/skin observation tasks within scope.

name: Continence risk
taskPlanEffect: Add individualized continence schedule/support and skin protection.

name: Palliative/end-of-life
taskPlanEffect: Reorient tasks toward comfort, symptom observation, dignity and goals of care.

name: Unintended weight loss / nutrition decline
taskPlanEffect: Add weight/intake trend monitoring, supplementation/diet-plan tasks and defined escalation thresholds.
escalationLink: Continued loss/poor intake/dehydration concern → clinical review / DT-003 / reassessment

name: High-frequency toileting / continence workload
taskPlanEffect: Add individualized toileting assistance with episode frequency/day-night pattern, hygiene/skin protection and workload capture.
escalationLink: Increase in frequency, inability, falls, skin change or urinary symptoms → clinical review
